pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, single rising dose and exploratory dose-finding in healthy male volunteers
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Incidence of drug-related adverse events (primary); reversal of dabigatran pharmacodynamic effect via aPTT, dTT, ECT, TT, ACT (secondary)
pivotal_trials.result: Administration of 5g idarucizumab (5g+2.5g split) resulted in immediate, complete, and sustained reversal of dabigatran anticoagulant effect within 30 minutes; dTT decreased from 48.7s to 31.4s, aPTT from 65.0s to 35.3s, ECT from 92.7s to 35.7s at 30 min post-dose, sustained through 72 hours

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 2-way crossover, single dose in healthy volunteers and subjects with mild/moderate renal impairment
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Pharmacodynamic reversal of dabigatran as measured by dTT and ECT (primary)
pivotal_trials.result: 100% of idarucizumab-treated subjects (46/46) achieved reversal of dabigatran-induced prolongation of clotting time by dTT and ECT regardless of dose (1g, 2.5g, or 5g), age, or degree of renal impairment; 0/46 placebo subjects showed reversal

pivotal_trials.design: Open-label, multicenter, single-arm, uncontrolled case series in dabigatran-treated patients requiring emergency surgery or with life-threatening/uncontrolled bleeding (REVERSE-AD trial; interim analysis)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Maximum percentage reversal of ECT or dTT within first 4 hours (primary)
pivotal_trials.result: Interim analysis (n=123): maximal reversal (100%) of dTT achieved in 98% (39/40) of Group A and 93% (26/28) of Group B patients; maximal reversal of ECT achieved in 89% (42/47) of Group A and 88% (30/34) of Group B patients; median maximum percentage reversal 100% (95% CI: 100, 100%) per published Pollack 2015 interim report (n=90); reversal sustained for at least 24 hours

key_safety: In 123 patients (Study 1321.3), 84% experienced any AE with the most common being hypokalemia (7%), delirium (7%), constipation (7%), pyrexia (6%), and pneumonia (6%); 26 deaths (21%) attributed to underlying serious conditions; 5 thrombotic events occurred 2–13 days post-dose in patients without antithrombotic therapy; no drug-related SAEs or discontinuations due to AEs were identified in healthy volunteer studies (1321.1/1321.2).
target_moa: Humanized monoclonal antibody Fab fragment that binds dabigatran with high affinity, neutralizing its direct thrombin inhibitory activity and reversing its anticoagulant pharmacodynamic effect

_meta.indication:
PRAXBIND is indicated in patients treated with Pradaxa when reversal of the anticoagulant effects of dabigatran is needed: 
- For emergency surgery/urgent procedures
- In life-threatening or uncontrolled bleeding
This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on a reduction in unbound dabigatran and normalization of coagulation parameters in healthy volunteers. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon the results of an ongoing cohort case series study.

indication_details.population_restrictions: patients treated with Pradaxa (dabigatran) requiring reversal of anticoagulant effects

supplements.description: Updated labeling only — this supplement fulfilled a postmarketing requirement (PMR 2977-1) by submitting the final clinical study report for the REVERSE-AD trial and made additional labeling changes related to administration and handling, with no new indication, population, dose, or use approved.
